name: Octree-based Raycasting
definition: Raycasting-Verfahren, das eine Octree-Struktur nutzt, um leere Raumregionen zu überspringen und die Traversierung zu beschleunigen.
summary: Octree-based raycasting accelerates volume rendering by using an octree to skip empty space, distinguished by maintaining voxel counts per node to support dynamic updates.
